thesis: Hold QQQ, IWM, and NVDA. Cash is $0, so any buy is a sale of one of those lines. Yahoo's '$89 billion reason to buy Nvidia' names the line I already hold, but the summary is empty, so it supports keeping NVDA rather than selling IWM to add. Job openings inching up as hiring slows is described as labor-market stability, not a small-cap catalyst against IWM. SPSM-versus-IJR is an unanswered question and neither has an open. An unnamed dividend king, BofA's unnamed fintech, an unnamed El Segundo firm in Tesla's slipstream, and '1 value stock' are not ordered. SpaceX's September challenges, Medtronic's earnings-call summary, Amphenol's September 2 calendar note, Rezolve AI, and Cerebras's Finland data center have no open in the tape. Bitcoin, ethereum, and Musk's Tesla pay versus Bitcoin are not equity orders. Oil costs gaining steam and a lookback of commodity ETFs name no US major, so I will not invent XOM. Invesco inflows and LQD slipping do not name QQQ. Yesterday's FTC Amazon lawsuit remains a reason not to buy AMZN. House PTRs are filings only, with no tickers.
